content.text:
**Recommendation: Sentry.** I'm working from memory, so check current pricing before you commit. All three change their plans often.

| | **Sentry** | **Rollbar** | **Bugsnag** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Best at** | Broad coverage: errors, tracing, performance and session replay in one tool | Fast, focused error tracking with strong grouping and deploy tracking | Mobile app stability, with release health and stability scores |
| **SDK/platform coverage** | The widest (100+ SDKs across web, backend and mobile) | Good for web and backend, thinner on mobile | Very good, especially on mobile (iOS, Android, React Native, Unity) |
| **Pricing model** | Based on event volume, with unlimited seats on paid plans. Team plan is roughly $26–29/mo. | Based on event volume, with unlimited seats. Entry tier is roughly $14/mo, and the next tier is about $49/mo. | Based on event volume and seats. It costs more at your size, roughly $59/mo and up for the paid tiers. |
| **Free tier** | About 5k errors/mo, 1 user | About 5k events/mo | Small, limited to 1 user |
| **Self-hosting** | Yes (open source, but heavy to run) | No | No |
| **Ecosystem** | Large community, many integrations (Slack, GitHub, Jira, Linear) and good docs | Solid integrations, smaller community | Integrations are good, and it sits inside SmartBear's product suite |
| **Weak spots** | Costs can climb when you add tracing and replay. Its default alerts are noisy until you tune them. | Fewer features beyond errors, and it is less actively developed | Priciest for a small team, and less useful if you don't have mobile apps |

**Why Sentry for a 10-person team**
- **Seats don't cost extra.** Unlimited users on paid plans means everyone can see errors without a seat conversation.
- **One tool covers more.** You get error tracking now, and you can add tracing and replay later without buying another product.
- **It fits any stack.** The SDK coverage makes it unlikely to be a poor fit, and hiring and onboarding are easier because most engineers already know it.
- **The cost is predictable.** You can set spend caps and inbound filters to keep volume under control.

**When to pick something else**
- **Choose Bugsnag** if mobile is your main product and you care about crash-free sessions and release stability. It's the best of the three there.
- **Choose Rollbar** if you only want server-side error tracking, plan to stay on a cheap tier, and want less to configure.

**Next step:** Start on Sentry's free tier or a Team trial. Wire it into your one or two noisiest services for a week, then check event volume against the plan limits. If you tell me your stack and expected error volume, I can make the pick more precise. I can also pull current pricing from their sites.
